jobs.title: Front End/Middleware Software Engineer - Terberg Automotive
jobs.description:
**Front End/Middleware Software Engineer (32–40 uur per week)**

  

Terberg Automotive is op zoek naar een Front End/Middleware Software Engineer.

Ben jij een ervaren developer met kennis van moderne frontend- en middlewaretechnologieën? Krijg je energie van het ontwerpen, bouwen en verbeteren van softwareapplicaties? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

  

**Wat ga je doen?**

Als Front End/Middleware Software Engineer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van onze softwareapplicaties. Je werkt aan front-end oplossingen en webbased systemen die bijdragen aan onze Connected Services. Samen met het team vertaal je functionele wensen naar toekomstbestendige en hoogwaardige software.

  

**Jouw taken:**

* Analyseren van de behoefte aan nieuwe functionaliteiten
* Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van nieuwe functionaliteiten en uitbreiden van bestaande systemen.
* Actief doen van verbetervoorstellen ter optimalisatie van onze applicaties.
* Ontwikkelen van (webbased) frontend-oplossingen binnen onze Connected Services‑omgeving.
* Zelfstandig bijdragen aan zowel front-end als middlewarecomponenten.
* Werken met moderne technologieën zoals Blazor, CSS/JavaScript/HTML5 en C#.
* Onderhouden en verbeteren van softwarearchitectuur en technische documentatie.
* Rapporteren aan de Team Lead Connected Services binnen de afdeling Development & Engineering.

  

**Wie jij bent**

Jij bent analytisch sterk, gestructureerd en hebt passie voor softwareontwikkeling. Je werkt graag samen binnen een technisch team, maar kunt ook zelfstandig uitstekend uit de voeten. Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe functionaliteit te creëren en zoekt actief naar manieren om onze systemen beter, sneller en slimmer te maken.

  

De meest ideale kandidaat heeft/is:

* Aantoonbare werkervaring met Blazor
* Ervaring met CSS/JavaScript/HTML5
* Ervaring met C#
* Kennis van Angular of ASP.NET is een pré
* Ervaring of affiniteit met Azure cloudoplossingen
* Analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en kwaliteitsgericht
* Proactieve houding en in staat om complexe technische verbanden te herkennen

  

Voldoe je niet volledig aan alle punten, maar ben je wél gemotiveerd om jezelf te ontwikkelen? Dan nodigen we je van harte uit om te solliciteren.

  

**Wat wij jou bieden**

Je wordt onderdeel van een internationaal opererend familiebedrijf waar je gezien wordt en jezelf kunt zijn. Daarnaast ontvang je bij ons:

  

* Een salaris van € 3.900 tot € 5.700 (afhankelijk van je leeftijd en ervaring).
* 25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV dagen op basis van fulltime dienstverband (40 uur/week).
* Reiskostenvergoeding
* Deelname aan het pensioenfonds via PMT
* Diverse opleidingsmogelijkheden
* Actieve personeelsvereniging

  

**Waar je terecht komt**

Terberg Automotive is gevestigd in IJsselstein en onderdeel van de Royal Terberg Group.

Binnen de Royal Terberg Group levert Terberg Automotive geavanceerde software- en hardware oplossingen voor de automotive sector. Veel Terberg producten zijn verbonden door ons product; Terberg Connect! Onder één dak ontwikkelen we software, werken aan systeemintegratie en bedenken én maken elektronische modules. Een enthousiast team focust zich op goede samenwerking om zichzelf continue te verbeteren en te innoveren. We zijn wereldwijd actief en in het leveren van oplossingen die de efficiëntie en duurzaamheid van Terberg producten bevorderen.

Toch zijn we nog steeds gewoon een Nederlands familiebedrijf met korte lijnen, waar je als medewerker echt gezien wordt. Met onze familiewaarden als uitgangspunt werken we bij Terberg op een eerlijke en betrouwbare manier. Wij investeren graag in onze mensen door middel van trainingen, het bieden van een veilige werkplek, fijne werksfeer en goede arbeidsvoorwaarden. Dat wordt ook gewaardeerd door onze medewerkers. Veel collega’s werken al jarenlang met veel plezier bij ons.

  

*Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Wij werven graag rechtstreeks.*

jobs.description:
**Wij bieden jou:**
-------------------

* € 3.886,- tot € 5.714,- bruto per maand op basis van kennis en ervaring (schaal 10 Cao Gemeenten - januari 2027 ) o.b.v. 36 uur fulltime;
* 17.05% IKB (Individueel Keuze Budget) bovenop je brutosalaris;

* Een uitgebreid onboardingsprogramma tijdens je eerste werkweek;
* Tijd- en plaats onafhankelijk werken;
* Een fijne thuiswerkplek;
* Fietsplan & volledige vergoeding OV: duurzaamheid staat bij ons hoog in het vaandel;
* Een eigen Zeist-Academie vol cursussen voor jouw eigen ontwikkeling.

**Dit ben je:**
---------------

* Voor deze functie zoeken we een Data Engineer met een stevige basis in data-engineering én de nieuwsgierigheid om zich continu te blijven ontwikkelen. Je krijgt energie van complexe datavraagstukken, maar begrijpt ook dat techniek pas waarde krijgt als collega's ermee verder kunnen. Daarom schakel je gemakkelijk tussen technische details en de praktijk van de organisatie.
* Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in een relevante richting, zoals Informatica, Data Science of Business IT. Daarnaast heb je minimaal één jaar werkervaring in een vergelijkbare rol. Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met Azure Databricks, Azure DevOps, SQL en Python en bent vertrouwd met datamodelleringstechnieken, zoals het Kimball-model. Ook heb je ervaring met zowel projectmatig als Agile werken. Ervaring met gemeentelijke processen en wet- en regelgeving is een pré, net als kennis van Power BI, Power Query en Azure SQL Server.
* Je bent analytisch sterk en weet complexe datasets te vertalen naar bruikbare inzichten en praktische oplossingen. Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de techniek. Je stelt de juiste vragen, denkt mee met de behoefte achter een verzoek en weet informatiebehoeften te vertalen naar passende datamodellen en informatieproducten.
* Daarnaast ben je resultaatgericht en voel je je verantwoordelijk voor wat je oplevert. Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor kwaliteit en zorgt ervoor dat afspraken worden nagekomen. Tegelijkertijd ben je proactief: je ziet kansen om processen, datastromen of informatievoorziening te verbeteren en neemt hierin zelf initiatief.
* Omdat je met veel verschillende collega's samenwerkt, zijn goede communicatieve vaardigheden belangrijk. Je weet complexe technische vraagstukken helder uit te leggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische collega's en kunt goed schakelen tussen verschillende belangen en niveaus binnen de organisatie. Je werkt graag samen, maar kunt ook prima zelfstandig keuzes maken en verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor je werk.
* Bovenal zoeken we iemand die nieuwsgierig blijft, nieuwe mogelijkheden onderzoekt en met enthousiasme wil bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van data gedreven werken binnen de gemeente Zeist. Daarmee komt niet alleen jouw expertise tot zijn recht, maar help je ook de organisatie verder vooruit.

**Dit ga je doen**
------------------

De gemeente Zeist heeft de afgelopen jaren flinke stappen gezet richting data gedreven werken. De basis staat: we beschikken over een Data Warehouse waarin veel databronnen zijn ontsloten en hebben een klein maar deskundig datateam. Steeds meer collega's weten de weg naar data te vinden. Tegelijkertijd zien we volop kansen om verder te bouwen. We willen data slimmer organiseren, nieuwe databronnen koppelen, de kwaliteit van data verhogen en nieuwe toepassingen verkennen. Als Data Engineer speel jij daarin een belangrijke rol.

Je komt terecht in het team Dataontsluiting binnen de afdeling Informatievoorziening. Samen met BI-specialisten, een GIS-specialist, een data-analist en een coördinator zorg je ervoor dat data toegankelijk en bruikbaar is voor de hele organisatie. Daarbij werk je veel samen met collega's uit onder andere het sociaal domein, het ruimtelijk domein, financiën, burgerzaken en HR.
  
  
Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag ontsluit je nieuwe CBS-data in het Data Warehouse, de volgende dag denk je mee over een dashboard voor HR of werk je aan nieuwe inzichten voor het sociaal domein. Je beweegt makkelijk tussen techniek en praktijk. Je begrijpt wat er technisch mogelijk is, maar ook wat collega's nodig hebben om hun werk beter te kunnen doen. Daardoor weet je informatiebehoeften te vertalen naar slimme en praktische oplossingen.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk is het beheren en doorontwikkelen van ons Data Warehouse. Je zorgt dat processen soepel blijven draaien, lost verstoringen op, richt nieuwe tabellen in en beheert toegangsrechten. Daarnaast werk je aan het ontsluiten van nieuwe databronnen, het verbeteren van koppelingen en het optimaliseren van datastromen. Je werkt in Azure Databricks en gebruikt daarbij Python en SQL. Samen met de BI-specialisten ontwikkel je dashboards en andere informatieproducten en adviseer je over de best passende inrichting en techniek.

Ook draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van datakwaliteit en data-governance. Ons Data Warehouse is onlangs naar de cloud verhuisd, waardoor er nieuwe mogelijkheden ontstaan. Denk aan toepassingen rondom AI en voorspellende modellen. Jij denkt graag mee over deze ontwikkelingen en neemt initiatief om nieuwe technische mogelijkheden verder te verkennen en toe te passen.

**Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden**

* Je beheert en ontwikkelt het Data Warehouse en zorgt voor een stabiele en betrouwbare dataomgeving.
* Je vertaalt informatiebehoeften vanuit de organisatie naar passende datamodellen.
* Je ontsluit en koppelt nieuwe databronnen en optimaliseert bestaande datastromen.
* Je werkt samen met BI-specialisten aan dashboards, rapportages en andere informatieproducten.
* Je draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van data-analyse en data gedreven werken binnen de gemeente Zeist.
* Je adviseert collega's over de mogelijkheden van data en informatievoorziening.

**Meer informatie & Solliciteren**
----------------------------------

Wil je inhoudelijk meer weten over de functie? Neem dan contact op met Mark de Graaff, Teamleider Informatievoorziening, via 06-33954451. Heb je vragen over de procedure of wil je weten hoe het is om te werken voor Zeist? Neem dan contact op met Ingrid de Jong, Corporate Recruiter, via 06-14892898 of ingrid.de.jong@zeist.nl. Kijk voor meer informatie over onze gemeente en werken bij Zeist op www.werkenbijzeist.nl en www.zeist.nl.

**Solliciteren**
  
Herken jij jezelf in dit profiel en wil je meebouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van data gedreven werken binnen de gemeente Zeist? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Vertel ons waarom jij kiest voor Zeist en waar je in jouw werk trots op bent. We zijn benieuwd naar jouw ervaring, ideeën en ambities.

**Enthousiast geworden? Reageer vandaag nog.** Er is geen sluitingsdatum voor deze vacature. Zodra wij jouw sollicitatie ontvangen, bekijken we deze en nemen we contact met je op.

**Dit is Zeist**
----------------

De gemeente Zeist is een moderne werkgever met medewerkers die betrokken en vooral zichzelf zijn. We werken op basis van onze kernwaarden ‘vertrouwen, kracht en nabijheid’. De werksfeer is open en prettig en onze cultuur is informeel. Met zo’n 600 collega’s werken we voor en met ongeveer 67.000 inwoners. Daardoor is het niet te massaal, zijn de lijnen kort en de mogelijkheden groot. Als organisatie willen we op de hoogte zijn van wat er in de samenleving speelt en daar flexibel op inspelen. We juichen het toe als je daaraan je eigen perspectief en waarde toevoegt en verwelkomen dus iedereen met de juiste ervaring en eigenschappen voor de functie. Waar je wieg ook heeft gestaan, wat ook je achtergrond, levensstijl of geloof is, of je nou topsporter bent of een beperking hebt, of allebei, als je je herkent in het profiel, solliciteer!
  
In Zeist werk je vanuit je eigen verantwoordelijkheid en word je ondersteund door de organisatie, zodat je als mens en als professional blijft groeien. We zijn niet op zoek naar een perfecte medewerker, maar iemand die zijn kwaliteiten, rafelrandjes én zelfkennis wil inzetten om met humor en lef uitdagingen te lijf te gaan.

jobs.description:
##### **Upgrade Your Career With Aira**

Clean-energy tech leads to a positive global transformation. Heating homes contribute to 15% of Europe's CO2 emissions. Switching to sustainable solutions offers households a way to achieve net-zero emissions.

Aira's mission is to advance the next generation of home energy solutions, creating intelligent, sustainable homes for a meaningful impact. Starting with innovative heat pumps, it will evolve into a comprehensive, intelligent clean energy-tech system and include dynamic electrical tariffs, cutting-edge home solar systems, and advanced battery storage solutions.

##### **About the role as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**

The survey/design visit is a key aspect of the customer journey to ensure an installation goes ahead as planned, and as the customer expects. You will find solutions to problems, ensure the project works in the interests of both the customer and Aira, and provide excellent customer service along the way. You will have the technical expertise to offer additional products and services we may offer in the interests of the customer.

##### **What you’ll be doing as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**

* Have the necessary qualifications, training, and experience to design high quality air source heat pump installations for domestic properties.
* Gather information from the quote, property and your survey data to generate an accurate heat loss calculation and emitter output requirements
* Find solutions to any technical issues where possible to ensure an installation can still go ahead
* Report any issues which may affect installation to your line manager from the customers property.
* Keep up to date with all manufacturer's guidance, and any legislative changes including but not limited to heat pumps, low carbon heating, clean energy, and building regulations.
* Operate within required Aira’s efficiency guidelines as well as MCS etc.

##### **What might a day look like?**

* Attend customer properties in your designated area
* Conduct a site survey and collect data relevant to the installation requirements
* Carry out a room by room heat loss assessment
* Determine which radiators need to be replaced, and communicate this with your customer
* Answer any technical queries the customer may have
* Communicate any price changes with the customer and explain the reason for these
* Obtain approval from the customer for your proposal to go ahead

### **Description**

**The Team**  
  
The Engineering team at FundApps is a team of ca. 50 smart, friendly people who collaborate closely and take pride in delivering best-in-class software and providing an extraordinary experience to our clients. We’re solving some of the most challenging problems in financial services - we operate in petabytes and milliseconds, not optimising the upload of cat photos. Our clients use our service for multiple hours a day - what we do as engineers has a real life impact on thousands of people across the globe!

Our team values are professionalism, sustainability, and psychological safety; we hold each other to high standards, give each other considered and constructive feedback, work smart, and look out for each other. Learn more about our engineering culture here.

  

### **What You'll Be Working On**

**The Role**

As part of the engineering team, you'll be working on a suite of innovative products that monitor over US$20 trillion in assets under management every single day, used by some of the world's largest Investment Managers. We are looking for a Mid-Level Back End Engineer who can help drive innovation and deliver great software at pace while also keeping sustainability in mind. We need highly motivated, intelligent people hungry for a challenge.

At FundApps, you'll see the inner workings of a fast-growing, bootstrapped scaleup where we expect all Engineers to take responsibility for their part in our success, seek support when needed, and care equally about our products and client outcomes as you do about writing code. We solve business problems through technology, not just ship code.

We like keeping our tech stack modern and are not afraid to invest to keep it cutting edge! As such we’ve recently completed major projects which included distributing our main rules engine using AWS services, migrated terabytes of data from SQL server to Aurora Postgres, replaced our Single Sign On service with Auth0 and converted our frontend to React.

**Our Tech Stack**

* Back-end: C#
* Data storage: PostgreSQL; Amazon storage including Aurora, DynamoDB, S3
* Infrastructure: Terraform and AWS, using Fargate, Lambdas, Step functions, and a lot more!
* Pipeline: GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Octopus Deploy, Serverless
* Front-end: React, TypeScript

  

### **What You'll Bring To The Team**

FundApps engineers have a lot of freedom to solve problems in a way that achieves our outcomes, and works within our values. You will not be micro-managed - in fact, it's the opposite - you will be expected to take ownership of your work from Day 1. To thrive at FundApps, you will need to be comfortable with uncertainty, and embrace change as it comes. We value people who take charge of their destiny and help make things better for everyone around them. We release software when it's ready, not on a schedule - our teams deploy multiple times a day.

We work agile, but do not follow any approach blindly - we seek 1% improvements in everything we do, try new things but don't hold to anything too tightly. Fundamentally, we follow a Kanban-inspired approach, but we also take inspiration from Team Topologies, 12-factor, DevOps culture - and all the good agile practices that you have read about. At FundApps we put these practices to work, reflect, and iterate to make sure our practices continue to serve us well.

Our Engineers look after a wide set of products and technical services; we don't strictly follow a micro-services approach, however we are working over time to evolve our codebase and our core technology to be distributed, cloud-native and resource- and cost-effective to power our growth while doing our bit to help FundApps be carbon neutral.

  

* **Background:** You are a mid engineer with generalist knowledge of product development concepts (software design, product requirements, work breakdown) and agile practices (TDD, CI/CD, architecture) and can apply them to solve well-defined problems independently and with your team. You are comfortable writing code in C#, Java or Python.
* **Work-with-purpose:** You can articulate the value of your own work in larger projects or team-wide goals. You have the space to own and deliver solutions and are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements.
* **Have-courage:** You are comfortable asking for and giving feedback. You help others when needed, and participate in debates, brainstorms, and other team conversations regularly. You build good relationships with your colleagues in Engineering, Product, and the wider company and are able to respectfully challenge each other to understand the problem and come up with the best solutions. As a company, we embrace change and the chance of failure.
* **Be-transparent:** As a company, we value and aspire for transparency at all levels; you’ll provide work updates to communicate regularly about progress and blockers and reach out for help when needed.
* **Raise-the-bar:** You seek out opportunities to improve our code, process, and practices; 1% improvements over time improve things for everyone.
* **Do-more-with-less:** You identify and help implement improvements to processes and standards within the team, seek to optimise our workflow, and share ideas for how to automate manual tasks. As a company we try to minimise meetings (we have meeting-free Wednesdays) and default to asynchronous written communication over long multiple person meetings.

  

### **A Few Things To Know Before You Apply**

**Work Eligibility**

We require candidates to have permission to work in the UK without visa sponsorship.

We work hybrid and ask that new FundAppers spend 3 days per week at our shiny London office during their first 6 months, to make the most of getting to know the business and other FundAppers.  
  
After that, our policy is at least 2 days per week in the office to collaborate, connect and enjoy our shared space and team activities.

**Life at FundApps**

Work/life balance with flexible hybrid working

Wellbeing benefits such as private health insurance, life insurance, a flexible stipend and mental health coaching

Matched pension contribution up to 10%

Peer micro-bonuses through Bonusly

£1,000 learning budget each year and unlimited professional development leave

Peer-led ‘Brown-bag lunch’ learning sessions and an annual Learning Festival

25 days holiday leave + an extra day next year if you use it all + an extra day after 3 & 5 years

5 Years @ FundApps - additional 4 weeks paid holiday leave during your 5th year as a FundApper

26 weeks leave for all new parents regardless of gender, location or family structure

❤️ Volunteering leave

Birthday off

We are proud of the diversity of all FundAppers - it makes us strong. We provide flexibility around religious observances and embrace a variety of cultural celebrations! If you’re looking for a workplace where you can just be yourself, you’re in the right place.

**Your Privacy**

Any information you submit through our job application process will be used for the purposes of assessing your fit for a role at FundApps. We may also retrieve and store information from your public social media profiles for the same purpose. By applying for this position, you consent to your data being processed in accordance with the FundApps privacy policy.

  

### **About FundApps**

FundApps is a company powered by experts, with a client community of 1000s and a culture underpinned by ethics. Oh - and we make the best regulatory software so our clients can “get a good night’s sleep now they have FundApps’❃[real client quote]

Many lawyers, ex-regulators, info sec and other experts work for the Certified B Corporation™ that is FundApps. We are all about future-proofing our compliance monitoring and reporting software so we can always monitor the £30trn (and growing) of AuM for the industry’s most active and happy global compliance community [we get top notch NPS + CSAT scores year after year].

Good people, good business, good ethics. We are FundApps.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we run one of the largest networks in the world supporting the AWS Cloud globally. In order to manage this unimaginable scale, we are driving revolutionary changes to the way networks are conceived, designed, built and operated. We put services and algorithms in place to control and manage all layers of the Amazon network, from top of the rack switches (TORs) to our internet and private backbone facing routers. This software ecosystem must be intelligent, scalable and fault tolerant. Our vision is to ultimately have self-managed networks and our Network Lifecycle Management (NLM) organization is responsible for building key services that will enable this vision.  
  
We are establishing a team of engineers that would build a set of foundational network services that form a core part of our Software Defined Networking (SDN) ecosystem. The main focus of the team will be to design and own a closed-loop system for the reservation of network entities associated to procurement activities. This service is vital for closing the gap between network capacity planning and our network automation systems. It is a crucial step towards our vision of a truly self-managed and adaptive network.  
  
We are looking for talented software engineers who want to get hands on experience with fully automated hyperscale data center networks, cloud infrastructure, large-scale software deployments, algorithms, distributed systems and service-oriented architectures (SOA). This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced and new Software Development Engineers wanting to solve some of the hard problems associated with config generation, modeling and storage at a large scale. No prior Networking experience required. In fact, we are looking for members with strong software services background to spearhead development of highly reliable scalable services.  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  
  
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As member of the team you will:  

* Design and develop highly scalable and reliable services that manage network configuration lifecycle.
* Work with peers, customers and partner engineering teams to develop state of the art solutions, incorporating new technologies, algorithms and innovations.
* Build technical roadmap to evolve our software services space
* Above all build a solid career path with an exponential learning curve, while having fun and making history!

  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  
  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

-------------

**Bygg neste generasjons digitale plattform for et selskap som omsetter for 8 milliarder kroner**

De fleste utviklere ønsker seg mer enn å bare levere kode.

De vil bygge løsninger som brukes. Ta tekniske beslutninger som betyr noe. Utforme arkitektur som skal leve lenge. Utforske nye utviklingsmetoder. Og jobbe sammen med andre som bryr seg om faget.

**Hvis det treffer deg, bør du lese videre!**

I Brødrene Dahl bygger vi en moderne digital tjenesteplattform som skal være fundamentet for fremtidens digitale tjenester, integrasjoner og forretningsprosesser. Nå ser vi etter en erfaren Senior .NET Developer som ønsker å spille en sentral rolle i denne satsingen.

Dette er ikke en rolle hvor du blir én utvikler blant mange i et stort konsern. Hos oss får du stor påvirkningskraft på både teknologi, arkitektur og måten vi utvikler programvare på.

**Dette skal du være med på**

Vi bygger løsninger basert på:

* .NET og C#
* Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
* Event-driven arkitektur
* Distribuerte tjenester og API-er
* Microsoft Azure
* CI/CD og automatisert leveranse
* AI-assistert utvikling

Vi ønsker å skape en plattform med tydelige domenegrenser, robuste integrasjoner og løs kobling mellom tjenester. Målet er løsninger som er skalerbare, vedlikeholdbare og enkle å videreutvikle.

Du vil få stor innflytelse på hvordan dette gjøres.

**Hos oss vil du**

* Utvikle moderne backend-tjenester og API-er i .NET og C#
* Bidra til arkitekturvalg og tekniske beslutninger
* Jobbe med Domain-Driven Design i praksis
* Designe og implementere event-drevne løsninger
* Omsette komplekse forretningsbehov til elegante tekniske løsninger
* Sikre kvalitet gjennom testing, code reviews og automatisering
* Videreutvikle CI/CD-praksis og utviklermiljø
* Delta aktivt i tekniske diskusjoner og faglige prioriteringer
* Bidra som mentor og sparringspartner for andre utviklere
* Utforske hvordan AI kan forbedre utviklingsprosessen og programvarekvaliteten

**Vi tror du kjenner deg igjen i dette**

Du har utviklet programvare lenge nok til å vite at de viktigste løsningene ikke nødvendigvis er de mest kompliserte.

Du liker å forstå domenet, stille spørsmål og ta bevisste tekniske valg.

Du ser verdien av god arkitektur, men er samtidig pragmatisk når situasjonen krever det.

Og kanskje viktigst: Du er en utvikler som tar eierskap til løsningene også etter at de er satt i produksjon.

**Vi ser gjerne at du har erfaring med**

* C# og .NET
* Moderne backend-utvikling
* REST API-er og systemintegrasjoner
* Domain-Driven Design
* Event-driven arkitektur og meldingsbasert kommunikasjon
* Distribuerte systemer
* Datamodellering og databaser
* Git, CI/CD og automatisert testing
* Azure eller tilsvarende skyplattform

Kjenner du ikke absolutt alt på listen? Det er helt greit. Vi er mer opptatt av sterke utviklere med gode tekniske prinsipper og lærevilje enn av en perfekt sjekkliste.

**AI er ikke en sideaktivitet hos oss**

Vi tror AI kommer til å endre hvordan programvare utvikles.

Derfor ønsker vi utviklere som er nysgjerrige på hvordan verktøy som GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT og andre AI-assistenter kan brukes til:

* Kodeutvikling
* Testing
* Dokumentasjon
* Problemløsning
* Effektivisering av utviklingsprosessen

Vi forventer ikke at AI erstatter fagkompetanse. Tvert imot. Vi ser etter utviklere som evner å kombinere sterk teknisk forståelse med moderne verktøy.

**Hvorfor Brødrene Dahl?**

Hos oss får du:

* En sentral rolle i en virksomhet med sterk digital satsing
* Reell påvirkning på arkitektur og teknologivalg
* Høy grad av autonomi og tillit
* Dyktige kolleger som brenner for teknologi
* Mulighet til å forme fremtidens utviklingsplattform
* Moderne teknologi og spennende integrasjonslandskap
* Gode utviklingsmuligheter både faglig og personlig
* Konkurransedyktige betingelser

**Klar for å bygge noe som faktisk betyr noe?**

Hver dag håndterer Brødrene Dahl varer, logistikk og tjenesteleveranser som holder byggeplasser, industri, VA-anlegg og samfunnskritisk infrastruktur i gang over hele Norge.

Løsningene du bygger vil ikke bare brukes. De vil være en sentral del av hvordan en av Norges ledende handelsvirksomheter opererer og utvikler seg.

**Send oss en søknad. Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg.**

**Om bedriften**
----------------

Brødrene Dahl er Norges ledende aktør innen VVS, vann og miljøteknikk (VA), samferdsel, industri og havbruk. Hver dag jobber vi tett på fagfolk over hele landet for å gjøre hverdagen deres enklere, mer effektiv og mer forutsigbar. Vi kombinerer solid fagkompetanse med moderne logistikk og digitale løsninger, og har miljø og bærekraft som en integrert del av hverdagen vår. Med 54 servicesentre, et landsdekkende logistikksystem og over 900 ansatte, er vi alltid nær kundene våre når de trenger oss.

Hos oss blir du en del av et sterkt fagmiljø med høy gjennomføringsevne, tydelige ambisjoner og stort handlingsrom.

Våre verdier er kompetente, offensive, samarbeidende og tilgjengelige.

**Would you like to use your skills to accelerate the global transition to a low-carbon circular economy?**

**About Cambi**

Cambi is a world-leading provider of sustainable technology solutions that enable cities to turn wastewater sludge into valuable resources. We are a medium-size, Norway-based multinational company listed in Oslo on Euronext Growth, with offices in several countries. We have diligent employees from different backgrounds and more than 25 nationalities, and a growing sales network covering all continents.

Our core expertise lies in designing, testing, manufacturing, installing, and operating industrial process installations, used mainly for treating sewage sludge before or after anaerobic digestion in wastewater treatment plants. The technology, known as thermal hydrolysis, reduces greenhouse gas emissions and produces renewable energy, organic fertilizers, and various soil products while destroying pathogens and other harmful substances. Our systems have the capacity to cater to over 120 million individuals across more than 28 countries. We are proud of having cities like Oslo, London, Washington, Singapore, and Sydney among our clients.

**About the Role**

As a Business Applications Architect, you will be the technical owner of Cambi's Microsoft 365 landscape, ERP, CRM, and the integrations connecting them. You will translate business needs into platform functionality, aligned with the strategic direction for each system, and own the overall technical architecture across the full life-cycle of the platforms and their integrations – from design and implementation to ongoing evolution. This includes safeguarding the integrity, quality, and availability of the company's data as it flows across these platforms. The responsibility spans from high-level architectural direction to hands-on technical implementation, ensuring that strategic intent and operational detail remain consistently connected.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Technically own the core business platforms and execute life-cycle enhancements to create business value.
* Define and maintain architectural principles, standards, and documentation for Cambi’s core business applications and integrations.
* Understand and translate business needs and foster cross-functional collaboration.
* Ensure key processes have optimal system support.
* Ensure technical changes are assessed and implemented with appropriate consideration for scalability, maintainability, security, data integrity, and life-cycle impact.
* Embed data-driven thinking into architecture and technical decisions.
* Operate within Cambi’s IT strategy, portfolio, priorities, and budget.

**We are looking for**

* A data-first and data-driven mindset with a holistic way of thinking.
* A consistent focus on ensuring that technology investments translate into tangible and measurable business value.
* A genuine interest in platform solutions and the broader ecosystem they are part of.
* A real appreciation for collaboration and cross-functional teams.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* A curious, technology-enthusiast approach to the work, with the drive and energy to help shape the role going forward.
* Confident leading and participating in well-defined processes and appropriately scoped projects.
* Willing to challenge the status quo, yet grounded and humble in how you do it.
* Not afraid to get your hands dirty with day-to-day operational work, coding, and configuration.

**Key qualifications and requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Relevant certifications and/or operational expertise within platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, ERP (platform-agnostic), CRM (Salesforce), integration development, and master data.
* Significant, demonstrable experience in a comparable role is equally valid and will be given weight against formal education requirements.
* Experience owning technical architecture and systems within a business context.
* Experience in integration development, ideally with a background in software development (full-stack or backend).
* Experience with system configuration and customization.
* Experience with data platform architecture and the data engineering layer.
* Hands-on skills in programming, scripting (PowerShell), and low-code (Power Automate, Power Apps) development within the ecosystem.
* Experience with development methodology, including backlog and priority management.
* Methodical project management experience, ideally from platform implementations or major upgrades.

At Cambi, we value people who share our commitment to the environment and the positive impact of the circular economy. Your personality should align with Cambi’s core philosophy, which centers around strong customer focus, delivering a high standard of quality in our solutions, products, and services, and always acting with integrity.

**Why Join Cambi**

* **Work globally:** Encounter different cultures and work practices when working with the global organization.
* **Make an impact:** Contribute to projects transforming organic waste streams into bioresources, boosting the circular economy, and leading to net-zero emissions in cities worldwide.
* **Immerse in diversity:** Join a multicultural team with a mix of young and experienced colleagues from more than 25 countries and 18 different disciplinary backgrounds.
* **Grow personally:** Embrace our values: quality, curious, reliable and teamwork, in a dynamic work environment grounded in a modern Code of Conduct applying to all employees and business partners.

**How to Apply**

If you’re ready to take the next step in your career with us, we’d love to hear from you. We kindly ask you to upload your CV and answer three questions regarding your motivation for the role.

Delivering on our mission to enable a swift global transition to sustainable communities is contingent on attracting and retaining talented employees from diverse backgrounds.

Deadline for applying is the **18th of October 2026.** Please be informed that we will only accept and assess applications through our career site.

**Contact**

For any questions about the role, you’re welcome to get in touch with:

* Kim Garberg, mob. 908 70 136, kim.garberg@cambi.com

RDG (Risk Decision Group) provides nationwide background investigations compliant with national government standards to include support of continuous vetting for over 110 government agencies.

Peraton is seeking an experienced **AWS Cloud Security Engineer** to design, build, and operate security controls for a FedRAMP Moderate-authorized AWS cloud infrastructure supporting Peraton's RDG (Risk Decision Group) program. This is a hands-on role with a key part in day-to-day cloud security operations, embedding secure-by-design principles into cloud architecture, and maintaining continuous FedRAMP compliance.

The engineer is responsible for implementing security architecture, hardening cloud environments, maintaining continuous compliance monitoring, and supporting Authorization to Operate (ATO) activities. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience securing AWS environments within a federal compliance framework (FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, NIST 800-171, RMF, or similar).

**This is a 100% remote position.**

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Design and implement security architecture for AWS workloads aligned with FedRAMP Moderate baseline controls
* Build and maintain security guardrails using AWS-native services (IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, CloudTrail, KMS, WAF, Macie, Inspector)
* Implement and manage Infrastructure as Code security controls (Terraform/CloudFormation) with policy as code
* Support System Security Plans (SSPs), ATO activities, and POA&M remediation
* Perform continuous monitoring, vulnerability scanning, patch management tracking, and monthly/annual assessment support
* Configure and maintain centralized logging, SIEM integration, and audit trail retention per FedRAMP/NIST requirements
* Implement least-privilege IAM policies, service control policies (SCPs), and cross-account access controls.
* Manage encryption at rest and in transit (KMS, ACM, TLS enforcement) per FIPS 140-2/140-3 requirements where applicable
* Respond to security incidents, perform root cause analysis, and support cloud-specific incident response playbooks
* Collaborate with DevOps/Platform teams to embed security into CI/CD pipelines (DevSecOps)
* Maintain documentation for control implementation statements, architecture diagrams, and audit evidence
* Support boundary definition and system categorization activities (FIPS 199) as required

##### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* US citizenship required; ability to obtain and maintain a Top-Secret eligible clearance
* Minimum 8 years work experience with BS/BA in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 5+ years of hands-on AWS engineering experience, with 3+ years specifically in cloud security roles
* Demonstrated experience working within a FedRAMP Moderate or FedRAMP High, DoD IL4/IL5, or equivalent federal compliance environment
* Experience supporting or maintaining an SSP and RMF processes
* Experience with AWS GovCloud (US), AWS Commercial, or equivalent federal AWS environments
* Strong hands-on expertise with AWS security services: IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail, KMS, WAF, Macie, Inspector, and Systems Manager
* Solid understanding of NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control families (AC, AU, CM, IA, SC, SI, etc.) and the ability to map implementations to specific controls
* 3+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation), including security scanning and policy-as-code tools
* Networking security fundamentals: VPC design, security groups, NACLs, PrivateLink, Transit Gateway, and network segmentation for compliance boundaries
* Experience with vulnerability management tools (AWS Inspector or similar) and remediation tracking
* Experience implementing Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) in AWS
* Familiarity with SIEM/log aggregation tools (Splunk, AWS CloudWatch, OpenSearch, or similar) for security event monitoring
* Scripting ability in Python or Bash for automating compliance checks and remediation
* Understanding of encryption standards relevant to federal systems (FIPS 140-2/140-3, TLS 1.2+)
* One of the following certifications: AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (with a security focus), or CISSP, CISM, or Security+ (with strong AWS hands-on experience).

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Direct experience supporting a Peraton program or similar federal integrator (Leidos, Booz Allen, SAIC, General Dynamics IT, etc.)
* Familiarity with server and systems hardening software
* Experience with container security (ECS/EKS), including image scanning (ECR scanning) and runtime protection

* Prior experience with change management processes in a regulated/audited environment

* Experience with AWS AI services (Amazon Bedrock)
* Experience with hybrid/multi-cloud architecture, including Azure (VNets, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure Policy, ExpressRoute)
* Experience with Microsoft .NET

* Familiarity with DevSecOps pipelines
* Familiarity with AI security and governance frameworks, national security/defense/critical infrastructure missions, and supporting federal agencies or large GovCon programs
